scenarios.name: a fresh group on the page: Did Mount, Children Count 4 (its buttons), Child Index 0, This itself — no Value, no Changed
Value from the graph: sent, never Changed; the same value again: nothing; another: sent
Value that is not text: a number, a boolean, a list and an object are converted by their toString; null and undefined are ignored (a text write beside them is sent)
a pick on a fresh group: Value and Changed; the same button again: nothing (it is selected); another: Value and Changed
the button with no Value is the selected one while the group's Value was never written: picking it raises nothing; once a Value is written it can be picked, and the Value goes back to nothing
a strict compare: Value "1" does not select the button whose Value is the number 1 — picking it sends the number and fires Changed; the number written back is converted to "1": sent, no Changed
a pick of a Value no button on the page carries: nothing to click (a pick of one that is there, beside it, fires)
Value written then the same button picked in one frame: the page paints first, so the button is already selected — nothing from the pick; the other button in the same frame fires
a pick of 'a', then Value written back to 'b' in the same frame: Changed for the pick, and the Value back at 'b' — the buttons show what the Value says, so picking 'a' again sends it with Changed

after a pick written back in its frame, picking the button the Value names raises nothing — it is the selected one; the next pick of 'a' fires (the runtime agrees for another reason: its screen still selects 'a', and the node already holds 'b')

a pick of 'a', then Value written back to 'b' in the NEXT frame: the buttons show 'b', so picking 'a' again sends it with Changed — C76's twin: a frame between the pick and the write-back, graded on both targets
Mounted off: Will Unmount, and a pick reaches no button; on: Did Mount, and the pick fires
Mounted off and a pick in the same frame: the paint takes the group off first — Will Unmount, nothing picked
placed off the page: no Did Mount, but Children Count is sent — the buttons are its children either way; a pick reaches nothing; Mounted on: Did Mount
placed with a Value: sent in the first frame; picking that button raises nothing, another fires
a pick before the first frame: the act paints the page (Did Mount) and picks — Value, Changed, Children Count all in frame 1
a remount keeps the Value: the selection starts from it again, so the picked button is still selected
Scroll Into View and the look ports: nothing on the wire (a Value write beside them is sent)
the pick's own paint: Mounted off, a pick, Mounted on in one frame — Will Unmount at the pick, Did Mount at the frame's end; and from off, on, a pick, off — Did Mount, then Will Unmount
the pick's own paint, nothing picked: placed off, Mounted on, a pick of no button, Mounted off in one frame — Did Mount at the pick, Will Unmount at the frame's end
Margin Top wired null: the style is removed, as for undefined — nothing moves on the wire and the node keeps working
Pos X wired undefined: back to 0 — nothing moves on the wire and the node keeps working
Visible off: a hidden group's buttons inherit the visibility — a pick reaches none, so nothing changes; shown again, a pick selects

trace.message: "height" is wired, and the parent stacks its children along that same axis, so the value arrived as a PERCENTAGE (dimension ports default to "%") and became flex-grow 100 — a ratio against the siblings that also grow, not a height.
